desc: Nigerian luxury fashion designer Mai Atafo is the go-to designer for many of the country's celebrities and politicians; in Lagos, Atafo talks to Larry Madowo about his training in the traditions of London's Savile Row, widely considered the gold standard in tailoring; he discusses why he wanted to bring those standards to Africa.

title: Inside Africa

title: African Voices

title: Connecting Africa

title: Marketplace Africa
